name: comp-218
title: Timezone Select
blurb: Select for choosing timezones with Intl offsets.
description: A select populated with all supported timezones via Intl.supportedValuesOf, formatted with GMT offsets and sorted by numeric offset for easy scanning.
use_when: You need a comprehensive timezone picker with human-readable offsets.
avoid_when: Simple timezone lists or when you want to restrict to a subset of zones.
a11y: Standard select behavior; timezone names read clearly.
